## The condition

Describe the state an organization drifts into. No single actor, no single moment — the weather,
not the event.

## Proposed name

## Adopt or coin?

**Does the industry already have a name for this?** If yes, adopt it and say so (shadow AI,
automation bias, and technical debt are examples of adopted terms). Only coin a new name where no
agreed term exists.

- [ ] Adopting an existing term — which one, and where is it established?
- [ ] Coining a new term — what did you search for, and what came up empty?

## "You've felt this when…"

The symptom line. What does this look like from inside an organization? This is the sentence that
makes people recognize their own workplace.

## Why it's dangerous

## Which personas does it feed?

Conditions raise the odds and cost of scenarios. Which Side 1 personas does this make more likely,
or harder to recover from?

## Control

What actually addresses it? Note especially whether the control **exists and fails**, or **does not
exist at all** — those need different fixes.

## Credit

How would you like to be credited? Name, handle, or not at all.
